description: This file defines a React functional component called AttendeeModal, which provides a modal dialog interface for managing attendees associated with an event. It includes UI elements for adding, removing, and saving attendee information, and interacts with external Modal component and event data types.

methods.name: handleAdd
methods.description: Adds a new attendee to the list if the input is non-empty and not already in the attendees list.

methods.name: handleRemove
methods.description: Removes an attendee from the list based on its index.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Placeholder for saving attendees to backend; triggers onClose to close the modal.
